## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

experimental data to new treatments and diagnostics.

Use Seven Bridges to discover more from your genomic and clinical data with immediate access to more
public datasets and bioinformatics tools than anywhere else.

public datasets.

* Bring NGS-based healthcare applications to the market faster

### **Customized national genomics**
* Deliver a purpose-built data ecosystem to drive research and discovery
* Operationalize end-to-end genomic data collection, curation, and analysis
* Deploy new analytic methods for population-scale genomic research
* Drive collaboration across institutions via secure and accessible data sharing

our scientists to learn more about our services.

# Experts in **genomics**

AllGenetics' expertise in high-throughput sequencing and bioinformatics ensures that we understand
your research needs to deliver high-quality results in an easy, personalised format.

[ [icon] Genomics for researchers ][51]
[ [icon] Genomic solutions for your company ][52]
[ [icon] Bioinformatics ][53]
[ [icon] Training ][54]
[ [icon] Genomic consulting ][55]
[The image is a green icon indicating that, as a general rule, AllGenetics tailors its laboratory
protocols and bioinformatics processes to your specific needs.]

## WE ADAPT—
## **SO YOU DON'T HAVE TO**

We tailor our lab protocols and bioinformatic pipelines to your specific needs. Our team will be by
your side from project design to data interpretation, answering questions as they arise.

[The image is a green icon indicating that, as a general rule, at AllGenetics we help you get the
most out of your samples: before, during, and after analysis.]

## YOUR ANALYSES
## **ARE IN EXPERIENCED HANDS**

You can rely on our team's extensive expertise. We help you get the most from your samples—before,
during, and after analysis.

[The image is a green icon indicating that, as a general rule, AllGenetics tailors its laboratory
protocols and bioinformatics processes to your specific needs.]

## WE CARE
## **ABOUT YOUR PROJECT**

Your dedicated project specialist is available during working hours. You'll work with real
scientists who are involved in your project—not machines sending automatic analysis reports.

## Your trusted **genomics company**

At AllGenetics we take pride in being a highly regarded genomic solutions partner since our
establishment in 2011. Our medium-sized team of highly skilled experts will work closely with you to
provide customised solutions to help you answer your research questions.

transcriptomes, and metagenomes.

We have designed OmicsBox to be user-friendly, efficient, and with a powerful set of tools to
extract biological insights from omics data.

OmicsBox is used by top private and public research institutions worldwide. It allows researchers to
easily process large and complex data sets, and streamline their analysis process.

# Turn complex life science data into clear next steps.

BioInf4Life supports academic groups, biotech teams and clinical collaborators with project-based
bioinformatics analysis, data interpretation and custom computational workflows.

[Explore services][12]
[Discuss a project][13]
[Chart icon]

### Analysis that answers the question

We connect statistics, biological context and readable reporting so results can move a project
forward.

[Compass icon]

### Publication-level analysis

Our publication record includes 60+ peer-reviewed papers, so figures, methods and interpretation are
built with publication standards in mind.

[DNA icon]

### From sequencing to insight

We cover the full path from sequencing and omics data through bioinformatics workflows to biological
insight.

[Bioinformatics data visualization]

Bioinformatics with biological context

## Data analysis that connects methods and meaning.

Modern omics projects generate more data than most teams can analyze in-house. We combine robust
pipelines, reproducible statistics and domain knowledge to help you identify patterns that are
biologically meaningful.
* Bulk RNA-seq, proteomics, metabolomics and multi-omics integration
* Single-cell and spatial data analysis
* Custom reports, figures and reproducible workflows

[View capabilities][14]

Clinical and translational projects

## Data analysis for real-world biomedical questions.

We collaborate with researchers, clinicians and companies to interpret complex data sets, validate
hypotheses and prepare results for decisions, grants and high-impact publications.

[Meet the team][15]
[Biomedical imaging]
[Artificial intelligence concept]

AI-ready bioinformatics

## Machine learning where it adds value.

Our team combines classical bioinformatics with machine learning approaches for pattern discovery,
data integration and scalable analysis systems.

[Start a conversation][16]

## Have data waiting for interpretation?

Tell us about your experiment, timeline and research question. We will suggest a practical analysis
path.

## Consulting Services

**Does this sound familiar?**
* Your pipeline works, but nobody dares touching it.
* Your cloud costs are unpredictable and growing.
* Your analysis depends on undocumented scripts from someone who left.
* You need to move from a working prototype to reproducible, auditable execution.

I work with teams that have the biology expertise and the data, but need someone to structure,
build, or improve their analytical infrastructure. Here's where I can help:

### Workflow Design

Designing and optimising bioinformatics pipelines: Nextflow, HPC, cloud-native.

Deliverables: pipeline code, container definitions, execution profiles, documentation.

### Cloud & HPC Architecture

Cloud infrastructure for genomics (GCP, Azure, OVHcloud), sized for your data and your budget.

Deliverables: infrastructure design, cost analysis, deployment scripts, scaling strategy.

### Reproducible Genomics Workflows

HLA typing, WGS, RNA-seq: end-to-end pipelines from raw data to traceable, auditable results.

Deliverables: analysis results, quality reports, reproducible workflow.

### Pipeline Audit

Your pipeline runs but you are not sure it is correct, reproducible, or cost-efficient.

Deliverables: technical report, risk assessment, prioritised correction plan, quick wins.

### Training & Mentoring

Workshops and mentoring on Nextflow, Bash, AWK, containers, and testing.

Deliverables: training materials, hands-on exercises, templates, follow-up support.

### Legacy Pipeline Migration

Modernising Perl, C, or Bash pipelines to Nextflow: original logic preserved, technical debt gone.

Deliverables: migrated pipeline, test suite, before/after comparison, transition guide.

### Fractional Bioinformatics Advisor

Senior bioinformatics guidance without hiring full-time. Architecture decisions, code reviews,
unblocking, mentoring.

Engagement: a few days per week or per month, adapted to your team's rhythm.

1. **Understand** the biological question and operational constraints.
2. **Audit** the current workflow, data, infrastructure and pain points.
3. **Identify** quick wins and structural risks.
4. **Build or refactor** with reproducibility, traceability and cost in mind.
5. **Transfer** knowledge through documentation, training and handover.

## Engagement Models

### Short Audit

A focused review of an existing pipeline, infrastructure or analysis setup. Typically 1-2 weeks.

### Build or Migration Project

A defined implementation mission with clear technical deliverables and a fixed scope.

### Fractional Support

A few days per month to advise, unblock and guide a bioinformatics team over time.

### Training

Practical workshops on Nextflow, scripting, containers, reproducibility and workflow engineering.

**Outcome:** reproducible analysis strategy for a population-scale cohort, with direct applications

**Outcome:** stable, auditable clinical workflows used daily by biologists for diagnostic

* Your pipeline works, but nobody dares touching it.
* Your cloud costs are unpredictable and growing.
* Your analysis depends on undocumented scripts from someone who left.
* You need to move from a working prototype to reproducible, auditable execution.

build, or improve their analytical infrastructure. Here's where I can help:

Deliverables: pipeline code, container definitions, execution profiles, documentation.

Cloud infrastructure for genomics (GCP, Azure, OVHcloud), sized for your data and your budget.

Your pipeline runs but you are not sure it is correct, reproducible, or cost-efficient.

unblocking, mentoring.

Engagement: a few days per week or per month, adapted to your team's rhythm.

5. **Transfer** knowledge through documentation, training and handover.

## About Me

I help research teams and clinical labs who have the biology expertise and the data, but need
someone to design, build, or modernise their bioinformatics infrastructure. With nearly 20 years at
the intersection of biology, computing, and systems architecture, I turn raw sequencing data into
analytical workflows that hold up in production.

On one side, code: Bash, AWK, Perl, Python, Groovy, Java, C. On another, infrastructure: HPC,
containers, cloud. In the middle, 20 years of genomics. I design Nextflow pipelines on Google Cloud,
Azure, and OVHcloud, and help teams figure out what compute setup actually makes sense for their
data and their budget.

I can work with nf-core and the Seqera Platform when they fit the context, but I also build
lightweight custom Nextflow pipelines from the DSL up, when teams need more control, lower cost, or
closer alignment with their biology. In 2018, I organised one of the first Nextflow trainings in
France, bringing its creators Paolo Di Tommaso and Evan Floden to Lille.

My bioinformatics experience covers HLA typing, variant calling, structural variant analysis,
annotation workflows (VEP, SnpEff), quality control (FastQC, MultiQC, Mosdepth, CoverM), expression
analysis (Cufflinks, featureCounts), metagenomics, and proteomics. I've used DRAGEN extensively, and
work daily with BWA, minimap2, HISAT2, samtools, bedtools, and GATK.

Whether it's tuning a SLURM scheduler, writing a Nextflow pipeline, or crafting an AWK one-liner, I
go straight to the root of the problem. KIS — Keep It Simple — is not a platitude, it's how I
actually work.

My background in Perl, C, and C++ is a genuine asset: I've been asked more than once to modernise
legacy pipelines built in these languages, and knowing them deeply — their idioms, their performance
characteristics, their failure modes — means I can migrate them faithfully to Nextflow without
losing the intent of the original logic. Most bioinformaticians today have never had to debug a
segfault or optimise a tight Perl loop. I have, and that matters when the job is to rewrite
something that works and make it work better.

## The Epistem Approach

[
About ][137]

Epistem prides itself on its commitment to providing reliable, innovative, and transferable models,
platforms and services to support decision making throughout the drug discovery, development, and
early clinical pipeline. With a track record of working with over 200 pharmaceutical and
biotechnology companies, we offer preclinical and clinical services that you can count on.

Our preclinical services include both in vitro and in vivo models, with a focus on oncology and
inflammatory diseases, as well as extensive experience in the gastrointestinal disease area,
including GI toxicities. We also offer organoid models for the modelling of complex physiological
systems and diseases.

Our GCLP-accredited laboratories also support clinical trials, providing histology, IHC and Image
Analysis, gene expression and DNA genotyping services.

We are proud to offer specialist research services that provide invaluable support to drug discovery
and development pipelines. Our experienced and highly skilled technical team is dedicated to
delivering custom protocols and personalised services of the utmost quality, tailored specifically
to meet your needs.

Contact us today to learn more about how we can help you achieve your research goals.

## The Epistem Approach

[
About ][137]

Epistem prides itself on its commitment to providing reliable, innovative, and transferable models,
platforms and services to support decision making throughout the drug discovery, development, and
early clinical pipeline. With a track record of working with over 200 pharmaceutical and
biotechnology companies, we offer preclinical and clinical services that you can count on.

Our preclinical services include both in vitro and in vivo models, with a focus on oncology and
inflammatory diseases, as well as extensive experience in the gastrointestinal disease area,
including GI toxicities. We also offer organoid models for the modelling of complex physiological
systems and diseases.

Our GCLP-accredited laboratories also support clinical trials, providing histology, IHC and Image
Analysis, gene expression and DNA genotyping services.

We are proud to offer specialist research services that provide invaluable support to drug discovery
and development pipelines. Our experienced and highly skilled technical team is dedicated to
delivering custom protocols and personalised services of the utmost quality, tailored specifically
to meet your needs.

Contact us today to learn more about how we can help you achieve your research goals.

# From Complex Data to Actionable Discovery

Transforming genomic data into meaningful insights for academic, clinical, and pharmaceutical
research. Accelerating discoveries that matter.

[ Explore Our Solutions ][43] [ Request a Quote ][44]

## How We Simplify Bioinformatics

Our streamlined process ensures you get from data to discovery, faster and more efficiently than
ever before.

1

### Data Submission

Securely upload your raw data through our easy-to-use portal with automated validation.

2

### Analysis & Interpretation

Our experts use proprietary pipelines and AI algorithms to analyze and interpret your data.

3

### Actionable Reports

Receive comprehensive, publication-ready reports with clear insights and visualizations.

## Our Bioinformatics Services

Comprehensive analysis solutions tailored to your research needs

### Genomics

Whole genome, exome, and targeted sequencing analysis with advanced variant calling and annotation.
* Variant Discovery & Annotation
* Family-based Analysis
* CNV/SV Detection

[ Learn More ][45]

### Transcriptomics

RNA-Seq analysis for differential expression, pathway enrichment, and functional annotation.
* Differential Expression
* Pathway Analysis
* Alternative Splicing

[ Learn More ][46]

### Metagenomics

Microbial community profiling and functional analysis from 16S and shotgun sequencing data.
* Taxonomic Classification
* Functional Profiling
* Diversity Analysis

[ Learn More ][47]

### Epigenomics

Analysis of DNA methylation, histone modifications, and chromatin accessibility data.
* DNA Methylation Analysis
* ChIP-Seq Analysis
* ATAC-Seq Processing

[ Learn More ][48]

### Single-Cell Analysis

Single-cell RNA-Seq analysis for cellular heterogeneity and developmental trajectories.
* Cell Clustering
* Trajectory Inference
* Differential Expression

[ Learn More ][49]

### Custom Solutions

Tailored bioinformatics pipelines and analysis workflows for specific research questions.
* Pipeline Development
* Script Optimization
* Cloud Integration

[ Learn More ][50]
[ See All Service ][51]

## Our Platform Suite

Proprietary platforms designed to accelerate your research workflow

### GeneAssure Platform

Cloud-based NGS analysis platform

[GeneAssure Platform]

An integrated platform for streamlined NGS data analysis, visualization, and collaborative research
management.
* Automated pipeline execution with version control
* Interactive visualization dashboard
* Team collaboration tools
* Secure data storage and sharing

[ Explore Platform ][52]

### RareVarDB

Curated rare variant database

[RareVarDB]

A comprehensive database of clinically annotated rare genetic variants with population frequency
data and pathogenicity predictions.
* Clinically annotated variants from global populations
* 20+ in-silico prediction scores
* Real-time updates from literature
* API access for integration

[ Access Database ][53]

# From Complex Data to Actionable Discovery

Transforming genomic data into meaningful insights for academic, clinical, and pharmaceutical
research. Accelerating discoveries that matter.

[ Explore Our Solutions ][43] [ Request a Quote ][44]

## How We Simplify Bioinformatics

Our streamlined process ensures you get from data to discovery, faster and more efficiently than
ever before.

1

### Data Submission

Securely upload your raw data through our easy-to-use portal with automated validation.

2

### Analysis & Interpretation

Our experts use proprietary pipelines and AI algorithms to analyze and interpret your data.

3

### Actionable Reports

Receive comprehensive, publication-ready reports with clear insights and visualizations.

## Our Bioinformatics Services

Comprehensive analysis solutions tailored to your research needs

### Genomics

Whole genome, exome, and targeted sequencing analysis with advanced variant calling and annotation.
* Variant Discovery & Annotation
* Family-based Analysis
* CNV/SV Detection

[ Learn More ][45]

### Transcriptomics

RNA-Seq analysis for differential expression, pathway enrichment, and functional annotation.
* Differential Expression
* Pathway Analysis
* Alternative Splicing

[ Learn More ][46]

### Metagenomics

Microbial community profiling and functional analysis from 16S and shotgun sequencing data.
* Taxonomic Classification
* Functional Profiling
* Diversity Analysis

[ Learn More ][47]

### Epigenomics

Analysis of DNA methylation, histone modifications, and chromatin accessibility data.
* DNA Methylation Analysis
* ChIP-Seq Analysis
* ATAC-Seq Processing

[ Learn More ][48]

### Single-Cell Analysis

Single-cell RNA-Seq analysis for cellular heterogeneity and developmental trajectories.
* Cell Clustering
* Trajectory Inference
* Differential Expression

[ Learn More ][49]

### Custom Solutions

Tailored bioinformatics pipelines and analysis workflows for specific research questions.
* Pipeline Development
* Script Optimization
* Cloud Integration

[ Learn More ][50]
[ See All Service ][51]

## Our Platform Suite

Proprietary platforms designed to accelerate your research workflow

### GeneAssure Platform

Cloud-based NGS analysis platform

[GeneAssure Platform]

An integrated platform for streamlined NGS data analysis, visualization, and collaborative research
management.
* Automated pipeline execution with version control
* Interactive visualization dashboard
* Team collaboration tools
* Secure data storage and sharing

[ Explore Platform ][52]

### RareVarDB

Curated rare variant database

[RareVarDB]

A comprehensive database of clinically annotated rare genetic variants with population frequency
data and pathogenicity predictions.
* Clinically annotated variants from global populations
* 20+ in-silico prediction scores
* Real-time updates from literature
* API access for integration

[ Access Database ][53]

# Welcome to my Home Page


I am **Dr. István Albert** and I am a **Research Professor of Bioinformatics** at the [Pennsylvania
State University][17]

My research career spans three scientific fields: bioinformatics, computer science, and statistical
physics.

Currently, my primary focus is bioinformatics, where I pursue both independent research and
collaborative projects through the **Bioinformatics Consulting Center**, which I direct. In this
role, I advise and work with scientists and students from a broad range of disciplines.
* [ORCID profile »][18] my researcher identifier
* [Google Scholar »][19] keeps track of what I've published
* [Biostars profile »][20] where I spend my social media time

## Contact Information

`Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology
Pennsylvania State University. 
Office: 206C Life Sciences Building 
Email: iua1@psu.edu
`

## Bioinformatics Teaching

I teach **BMMB 852: Applied Bioinformatics** as part of the resident instruction program.
* Fall 2025: Mon/Wed 1:25PM - 2:15PM, Business Bld 102

The course typically reaches capacity soon after registration opens, so early enrollment is
recommended.

## Bioinformatics Consulting

I am the director of the **Bioinformatics Consulting Center (BCC)** at Penn State, which provides
bioinformatics data analysis services across the full range of high-throughput sequencing
applications.

Our work spans from routine data processing to the development of novel, domain-specific
methodologies. To date, we have contributed to hundreds of projects across the life sciences.

The center also manages and distributes sequencing data generated by the **Penn State Genomics Core
Sequencing Facilities**.

Penn State affiliates interested in our services may contact me at `iua1@psu.edu`

## The Biostar Handbook

Bioinformatics education remains inadequate worldwide. Much of the coursework fails to provide
sufficient training, leading to persistent misconceptions and fallacies.

Substantial resources are wasted on ineffective formats such as weekend workshops, recipe-style
guides, and over-automated tutorials - that create an illusion of learning without building genuine
problem-solving skills.

To address this gap, I developed the [Biostar Handbook][21]. What began as a single volume has since
expanded into a series dedicated to practical bioinformatics data analysis.

────────────────────┬─────────────────────┬─────────────────┬────────────────────┬──────────────────
[The Biostar        │[Bioinformatics      │[RNA-Seq         │[Coronavirus        │[Biostar          
Handbook][22]       │Scripting][23]       │Analysis][24]    │Analysis][25]       │Workflows][26]    
────────────────────┴─────────────────────┴─────────────────┴────────────────────┴──────────────────

The Biostar Handbook series introduces readers to bioinformatics—a discipline at the intersection of
biology, computer science, and statistical data analysis—focused on the digital processing of
genomic information.
* [The Biostar Handbook][27] - An introduction to Bioinformatics as a scientific field.
* [The Art of Bioinformatics Scripting][28] - Learn advanced Unix and Bash scripting skills.
* [RNA-Seq by Example][29] - Master RNA-Seq data analysis.
* [Corona Virus Genome Analysis][30] - Advanced topics devoted to the study of the Coronavirus.
* [Biostar Workflows][31] - Best practices for developing bioinformatics pipelines.

## Biostar Q&A Forum

More than fifteen years ago, I founded [Biostars: Question and Answer][32], an open-source platform
designed to support and sustain scientific communities.

Today, the site serves a large global audience and has become the most widely visited bioinformatics
information resource in the world.

Over the years, [Biostar-powered][33] sites have supported millions of users and delivered hundreds
of millions of page views. The source code is available at [Biostar Central][34]

## Scientific Software

I also enjoy developing software tools that make complex data easier to explore:
* [genescape][35] — a visualization tool for exploring gene functions
* [bio][36] — a project designed to make bioinformatics fun again

... and many others.

## Weekend Cowboy

Scientist by day, hiker and traveler on weekends. Follow my adventures on my YouTube channel.

Substantial resources are wasted on ineffective formats such as weekend workshops, recipe-style
guides, and over-automated tutorials - that create an illusion of learning without building genuine
problem-solving skills.

To address this gap, I developed the [Biostar Handbook][21]. What began as a single volume has since
expanded into a series dedicated to practical bioinformatics data analysis.

The Biostar Handbook series introduces readers to bioinformatics—a discipline at the intersection of
biology, computer science, and statistical data analysis—focused on the digital processing of
genomic information.
* [The Biostar Handbook][27] - An introduction to Bioinformatics as a scientific field.
* [The Art of Bioinformatics Scripting][28] - Learn advanced Unix and Bash scripting skills.
* [RNA-Seq by Example][29] - Master RNA-Seq data analysis.
* [Corona Virus Genome Analysis][30] - Advanced topics devoted to the study of the Coronavirus.
* [Biostar Workflows][31] - Best practices for developing bioinformatics pipelines.

## Biostar Q&A Forum

More than fifteen years ago, I founded [Biostars: Question and Answer][32], an open-source platform
designed to support and sustain scientific communities.

Today, the site serves a large global audience and has become the most widely visited bioinformatics
information resource in the world.

Over the years, [Biostar-powered][33] sites have supported millions of users and delivered hundreds
of millions of page views. The source code is available at [Biostar Central][34]

## Scientific Software

I also enjoy developing software tools that make complex data easier to explore:
* [genescape][35] — a visualization tool for exploring gene functions
* [bio][36] — a project designed to make bioinformatics fun again

# Welcome to my Home Page


I am **Dr. István Albert** and I am a **Research Professor of Bioinformatics** at the [Pennsylvania
State University][17]

My research career spans three scientific fields: bioinformatics, computer science, and statistical
physics.

Currently, my primary focus is bioinformatics, where I pursue both independent research and
collaborative projects through the **Bioinformatics Consulting Center**, which I direct. In this
role, I advise and work with scientists and students from a broad range of disciplines.

## Bioinformatics Teaching

* Fall 2025: Mon/Wed 1:25PM - 2:15PM, Business Bld 102

recommended.

bioinformatics data analysis services across the full range of high-throughput sequencing
applications.

methodologies. To date, we have contributed to hundreds of projects across the life sciences.

The center also manages and distributes sequencing data generated by the **Penn State Genomics Core

# Global Bioinformatics Services

Discover our comprehensive bioinformatics services and statistical data analysis solutions to help
you transform lives and improve human health. 




[ Our services ][43]

## Make your data analysis efficient

KonAnBio specialises in bioinformatics solutions, providing healthcare practitioners with flexible
and customizable services required to effectively analyse and manage vast quantities of data. Our
complete services are offered either as standalone or in conjunction with our Next Generation
Sequencing Services. We use leading-edge technology to help you put science into improving human
health. Whatever the project or the area you are working on, in addition to various bioinformatics
solutions, you will benefits from support every stage of the process.

### DNA sequencing data analysis

DNA sequencing is a general laboratory technique used to identify and analyse genetic variants that
make up the DNA molecule. This helps to find out what sort of genetic information is carried in a
particular DNA segment.
[ Read More ][44]

### RNA sequencing data analysis

RNA-sequencing examines the quantity and sequences of RNA in a sample using next-generation
sequencing. By using RNA-seq scientists can better understand a cell biology and assess abnormal
changes that may indicate disease.
[ Read More ][45]

### Single-cell RNA sequencing data analysis

Single‐cell RNA sequencing is a state‐of‐the‐art approach that can be used to explain the
heterogeneity and complexity of RNA transcripts within individual cells, to better understand health
and diseases.
[ Read More ][46]

### Epigenomic data analysis

Epigenomics is the study of epigenetic modifications across the entire genome of an organism.
Epigenetics refers to heritable changes in gene function that do not involve alterations to the
underlying DNA sequence. Instead, these changes involve modifications to DNA molecules or associated
proteins, influencing gene expression and cellular function.
[ Read More ][47]

### Proteomic data analysis

Proteomics deals with the study of all the expressed proteins in an organism. With Pproteomics
analysis you have a better understanding of the structure and function of the organism. More
specific, proteomics look at how different proteins interact with each other and the roles they play
within the organism.
[ Read More ][48]

### Metagenomics data analysis

Metagenomics deals with the study of the structure and function of entire nucleotide sequences
isolated and analysed from all the organisms. This type of analysis is often used to study a
specific community of microorganisms, such as those residing on human skin, in the soil or in a
water sample. Metagenomics explores a mixture of DNA from multiple organisms and entities, such as
viruses, viroids and free DNA.
[ Read More ][49]

## Transform lives. Improve human health

At KonAnBio we combine our experience in basic research, technology development, diagnostics, and
therapeutics with the latest technology to provide expert bioinformatics services and innovative
computational solutions to science companies from all over the world. Our company has experience in
providing bioinformatics services and statistical data analysis solutions for small and large
projects, including clinical trials and research. 

After more than a decade of experience in computer science and technology, working on various

## Make your data analysis efficient

KonAnBio specialises in bioinformatics solutions, providing healthcare practitioners with flexible
and customizable services required to effectively analyse and manage vast quantities of data. Our
complete services are offered either as standalone or in conjunction with our Next Generation
Sequencing Services. We use leading-edge technology to help you put science into improving human
health. Whatever the project or the area you are working on, in addition to various bioinformatics
solutions, you will benefits from support every stage of the process.

### DNA sequencing data analysis

DNA sequencing is a general laboratory technique used to identify and analyse genetic variants that
make up the DNA molecule. This helps to find out what sort of genetic information is carried in a
particular DNA segment.
[ Read More ][44]

### RNA sequencing data analysis

RNA-sequencing examines the quantity and sequences of RNA in a sample using next-generation
sequencing. By using RNA-seq scientists can better understand a cell biology and assess abnormal
changes that may indicate disease.
[ Read More ][45]

### Single-cell RNA sequencing data analysis

Single‐cell RNA sequencing is a state‐of‐the‐art approach that can be used to explain the
heterogeneity and complexity of RNA transcripts within individual cells, to better understand health
and diseases.
[ Read More ][46]

### Epigenomic data analysis

Epigenomics is the study of epigenetic modifications across the entire genome of an organism.
Epigenetics refers to heritable changes in gene function that do not involve alterations to the
underlying DNA sequence. Instead, these changes involve modifications to DNA molecules or associated
proteins, influencing gene expression and cellular function.
[ Read More ][47]

### Proteomic data analysis

Proteomics deals with the study of all the expressed proteins in an organism. With Pproteomics
analysis you have a better understanding of the structure and function of the organism. More
specific, proteomics look at how different proteins interact with each other and the roles they play
within the organism.
[ Read More ][48]

### Metagenomics data analysis

Metagenomics deals with the study of the structure and function of entire nucleotide sequences
isolated and analysed from all the organisms. This type of analysis is often used to study a
specific community of microorganisms, such as those residing on human skin, in the soil or in a
water sample. Metagenomics explores a mixture of DNA from multiple organisms and entities, such as
viruses, viroids and free DNA.
[ Read More ][49]

support undergraduate and graduate students, with particular usefulness for exam preparation in

# OmicsBox 3.4

Renowned bioinformatics company Biobam S.L. recently launched its new complete bioinformatics
solution named OmicsBox which has replaced Blast2GO completely. OmicsBox is a bioinformatics
software solution that allows getting from reads to insights with ease. Use OmicsBox for the NGS
data analysis of genomes, transcriptomics, and metagenomes. OmicsBox is structured in Modules.
Depending on your needs you can combine different modules required for your data analysis.

[Read more][11]
[Molquest]

# MolQuest 2.4.5

MolQuest is the most comprehensive, easy-to-use desktop application for sequence analysis and
molecular biology data management available in the market today. The package includes versatile
family of gene finders, FGENESH/H+, with parameters for wide variety of genomes, as well as
pipelines for fully automatic annotation of eukaryotic (FGENESH++) and bacterial (FGENESB) genomes,
which proved to be the most accurate gene finding tools overall The package has a user-friendly
interface for sequence editing, primer design, internet database searches, gene prediction, promoter
identification, regulatory elements mapping, patterns discovery protein analysis, multiple sequence
alignment, phylogenetic tree reconstruction, and a wide variety of other functions.

[Read more][12]
[MapQTL]

# MapQTL ® 7

Analyze your QTL experiments with interval mapping, with the powerful MQM mapping (=composite
interval mapping), or with a nonparametric method. MapQTL 7 is easy to use, is very fast, and
presents the analysis results in tables and (adjustable) charts that can be exported to MS-Windows
text processing and presentation software.

[Read more][13]
[JoinMAP]

# JoinMap ® 5

JoinMap ® 5 provides high-quality tools that allow detailed study of the experimental data and the
generation of publication-ready map charts. The intuitive MS Windows user interface of JoinMap
invites a better exploration of the data. For instance, you can perform several diagnostical tests,
both before and after the actual map calculation, and you can remove potentially erroneous loci and
individuals from the map calculations with a simple mouse click.

[Read more][14]
[NTSYS PC]

# NTSYS PC

NTSYSpc can be used to discover pattern and structure in multivariate data. The phylogenetic tree
either using the neighbor-joining or UPGMA methods for constructing dendrograms. NTSYSpc can
transform data, estimate dis/similarities among objects, and prepare summaries of the relationships
using cluster analysis, ordination, and multiple factor analyses. Many of the results can be shown
both numerically and graphically.

[Read more][15]

# OmicsBox 3.4

Renowned bioinformatics company Biobam S.L. recently launched its new complete bioinformatics
solution named OmicsBox which has replaced Blast2GO completely. OmicsBox is a bioinformatics
software solution that allows getting from reads to insights with ease. Use OmicsBox for the NGS
data analysis of genomes, transcriptomics, and metagenomes. OmicsBox is structured in Modules.
Depending on your needs you can combine different modules required for your data analysis.

[Read more][11]
[Molquest]

# MolQuest 2.4.5

MolQuest is the most comprehensive, easy-to-use desktop application for sequence analysis and
molecular biology data management available in the market today. The package includes versatile
family of gene finders, FGENESH/H+, with parameters for wide variety of genomes, as well as
pipelines for fully automatic annotation of eukaryotic (FGENESH++) and bacterial (FGENESB) genomes,
which proved to be the most accurate gene finding tools overall The package has a user-friendly
interface for sequence editing, primer design, internet database searches, gene prediction, promoter
identification, regulatory elements mapping, patterns discovery protein analysis, multiple sequence
alignment, phylogenetic tree reconstruction, and a wide variety of other functions.

[Read more][12]
[MapQTL]

# MapQTL ® 7

Analyze your QTL experiments with interval mapping, with the powerful MQM mapping (=composite
interval mapping), or with a nonparametric method. MapQTL 7 is easy to use, is very fast, and
presents the analysis results in tables and (adjustable) charts that can be exported to MS-Windows
text processing and presentation software.

[Read more][13]
[JoinMAP]

# JoinMap ® 5

JoinMap ® 5 provides high-quality tools that allow detailed study of the experimental data and the
generation of publication-ready map charts. The intuitive MS Windows user interface of JoinMap
invites a better exploration of the data. For instance, you can perform several diagnostical tests,
both before and after the actual map calculation, and you can remove potentially erroneous loci and
individuals from the map calculations with a simple mouse click.

[Read more][14]
[NTSYS PC]

# NTSYS PC

NTSYSpc can be used to discover pattern and structure in multivariate data. The phylogenetic tree
either using the neighbor-joining or UPGMA methods for constructing dendrograms. NTSYSpc can
transform data, estimate dis/similarities among objects, and prepare summaries of the relationships
using cluster analysis, ordination, and multiple factor analyses. Many of the results can be shown
both numerically and graphically.

[Read more][15]

Core Workflow

## From raw FASTQ sequencing reads to validated insights.

Our containerized, reproducible bioinformatics workflows ensure that raw sequencing datasets are
quality controlled, mapped, and mathematically modeled with full scientific rigor.

01
Ingestion & Quality Inspection
Adapter removal, fastp trimming, and automated multi-sample quality control reporting via MultiQC.
02
Alignment & Expression Counting
Ultra-fast genomic mapping using STARSpliced Transcripts Alignment to a Reference - high speed
RNA-seq aligner., HISAT2, or de novo transcripts quantification using Salmon.
03
Signal Modeling & Statistics
Differential expression modeling (DESeq2), cell clustering (Seurat/Scanpy), or variant detection
(GATK4).
04
Reporting & Visual Dashboards
Clean, publication-ready figures, annotated tables, interactive browser dashboards, and Nextflow
pipeline logs.

Core Workflow

## From raw FASTQ sequencing reads to validated insights.

Our containerized, reproducible bioinformatics workflows ensure that raw sequencing datasets are
quality controlled, mapped, and mathematically modeled with full scientific rigor.

01
Ingestion & Quality Inspection
Adapter removal, fastp trimming, and automated multi-sample quality control reporting via MultiQC.
02
Alignment & Expression Counting
Ultra-fast genomic mapping using STARSpliced Transcripts Alignment to a Reference - high speed
RNA-seq aligner., HISAT2, or de novo transcripts quantification using Salmon.
03
Signal Modeling & Statistics
Differential expression modeling (DESeq2), cell clustering (Seurat/Scanpy), or variant detection
(GATK4).
04
Reporting & Visual Dashboards
Clean, publication-ready figures, annotated tables, interactive browser dashboards, and Nextflow
pipeline logs.

# Locations

Rosalind is a platform for learning bioinformatics and programming through problem solving. [Take a
tour][19] to get the hang of how Rosalind works.

If you don't know anything about programming, you can start at the [Python Village][20]. For a
collection of exercises to accompany Bioinformatics Algorithms book, go to the [Textbook Track][21].
Otherwise you can try to storm the [Bioinformatics Stronghold][22] right now.

[

Python Village

][23]
If you are completely new to programming, try these initial problems to learn a few basics about the
Python programming language. You'll get familiar with the operations needed to start solving
bioinformatics challenges in the Stronghold.
[

Bioinformatics Stronghold

][24]
Discover the algorithms underlying a variety of bioinformatics topics: computational mass
spectrometry, alignment, dynamic programming, genome assembly, genome rearrangements, phylogeny,
probability, string algorithms and others.
[

Bioinformatics Armory

][25]
Ready-to-use software tools abound for bioinformatics analysis. Whereas in the Stronghold you
implement algorithms on your own, in the Armory you solve similar problems by using existing tools.
[

Bioinformatics Textbook Track

][26]
A collection of exercises to accompany Bioinformatics Algorithms: An Active-Learning Approach by
Phillip Compeau & Pavel Pevzner. A full version of this text is hosted on stepic.org
[

Algorithmic Heights

][27]
A collection of exercises in introductory algorithms to accompany "Algorithms", the popular textbook
by Dasgupta, Papadimitriou, and Vazirani.

# Locations

Rosalind is a platform for learning bioinformatics and programming through problem solving. [Take a
tour][19] to get the hang of how Rosalind works.

If you don't know anything about programming, you can start at the [Python Village][20]. For a
collection of exercises to accompany Bioinformatics Algorithms book, go to the [Textbook Track][21].
Otherwise you can try to storm the [Bioinformatics Stronghold][22] right now.

[

Python Village

][23]
If you are completely new to programming, try these initial problems to learn a few basics about the
Python programming language. You'll get familiar with the operations needed to start solving
bioinformatics challenges in the Stronghold.
[

Bioinformatics Stronghold

][24]
Discover the algorithms underlying a variety of bioinformatics topics: computational mass
spectrometry, alignment, dynamic programming, genome assembly, genome rearrangements, phylogeny,
probability, string algorithms and others.
[

Bioinformatics Armory

][25]
Ready-to-use software tools abound for bioinformatics analysis. Whereas in the Stronghold you
implement algorithms on your own, in the Armory you solve similar problems by using existing tools.
[

Bioinformatics Textbook Track

][26]
A collection of exercises to accompany Bioinformatics Algorithms: An Active-Learning Approach by
Phillip Compeau & Pavel Pevzner. A full version of this text is hosted on stepic.org
[

Algorithmic Heights

][27]
A collection of exercises in introductory algorithms to accompany "Algorithms", the popular textbook
by Dasgupta, Papadimitriou, and Vazirani.

# Custom Bioinformatics Services for Rigorous Research

Established in 2013, AccuraScience was the first bioinformatics service company in the U.S. to offer
broad-spectrum, customized data analysis for academic and industry researchers. We’ve completed over
400 successful projects for more than 180 institutions worldwide, backed by a team of expert
bioinformaticians with over 200 years of combined experience.

[Explore Services][1] [Request a Quote][2]

### [ Our Services][3]

We offer expert-driven bioinformatics support across genomics, transcriptomics, epigenomics,
single-cell, spatial transcriptomics, multi-omics integration, microbiome, GWAS/EWAS/TWAS,
proteomics, and machine learning - with full customization to your research goals. Explore what we
offer and how we can support your next project. [Learn More][4]

### [Our Capacities][5]

Our team brings over 200 years of combined experience in bioinformatics research and development -
built upon advanced training in both biology and computation. Many of our senior scientists hold
degrees in both domains, and have served as faculty at major U.S. institutions as well as worked in
industry. You’ll work directly with these experts - no outsourcing, no black-box tools. [Learn
More][6]

### [About Us][7]

> Founded in June 2013, AccuraScience was the first bioinformatics service company in the U.S.
> offering broad-spectrum customized bioinformatics solutions to academic and industry researchers.
> Learn about our mission, global reach, and how we've completed over 400 projects for 180+
